added: Add TaxonomyRegistry and shippedTaxonomies: forForm(form) gives the taxonomy a dance of that form is edited and parsed with, anyForm resolves a stored move ID of any form, and other forms' IDs carry their form's prefix (ecd_, ADR-006 §5.1).
changed: DanceRepository and CompendiumRepositories take an optional taxonomyForForm, with which a dance's import-gap lines are re-parsed by its own form; exports' default renderers use the any-form taxonomy.
